It cannot apply attributes to [[Boss]]es or other '''Mutagenic Blights'''. |ability1_cooldown = 7.5 }} ==Description== The '''Mutagenic Blight''', internally referred to as '''Hex Weaver''', is a support enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has high health, slightly slow speed and 50% defense, reducing most forms of damage by 33%. It is also introduced in its wave as a [[Boss]], giving it the immunities that the modifier includes. The '''Mutagenic Blight''' has one ability, ''Uncontrollable Mutation'', where it throws a green orb on the path that applies attributes to other enemies in an explosion range of 5. The explosion applies [[Bloated]] or [[Nimble]] attributes to enemies. It can not apply attributes to [[Boss]]es or other '''Mutagenic Blights'''. The '''Mutagenic Blight''' can be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. ==Appearance== The '''Mutagenic Blight''' has black skin. It wears a grey shirt and shoes, blue pants, dark grey armbands with bloody spikes and dark grey shoulder-pads. It also wears a dark grey animal skull with multiple horns on its head. It holds a turquoise orb in its hands, which it uses to apply attributes to enemies. It has a death animation where it falls over on its back, its orb falling on its face in the process. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |[[Mutation]] |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |500 |- !Wave !Health |- |18 |10,500 |- |19 |11,000 |- |20 |11,500 |- |21 |12,000 |- |22 |12,500 |- |23 |13,000 |- |24 |13,500 |- |25 |14,000 |} ==Strategy== *While not a threat on its own, especially considering how multiple enemies at this stage of the mode are significantly stronger than it, its ability to apply buffs to other strong enemies makes it very dangerous. **As with most other high-health enemies, DPS towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended. **Stalling towers can be used to slow down enemies that are given the [[Nimble]] attribute. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| HexWeaverWalk.gif|Walking animation (19 February 2025 – Present) HexWeaverThrow.gif|''Uncontrollable Mutation'' animation (19 February 2025 – Present) HexWeaverDeath.gif|''Death'' animation (19 February 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1HexWeaver.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHexWeaver.png|Second Corpse variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} HexWeaverIconIG.png|'''Hex Weaver''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Mutagenic Blight''' is a renamed version of the [[Hex Weaver]]. *The '''Mutagenic Blight''' animations and ability are identical to the [[Hex Weaver]] and the [[Fallen Jester]]. *Similarly to the [[Fallen Jester]], the '''Mutagenic Blight''' has an ignore list of enemies it will not throw its orbs at. However, that list is actually reused from the [[Hex Weaver]], meaning none of the enemies in it can actually be seen. **Enemies which can be seen being ignored by the '''Mutagenic Blight''' in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] include the '''Mutagenic Blight''' itself, [[Reaver]], [[Reaper]] and [[Conjurer]]. ***The [[Reaver]] did not appear in the [[Hexscape Event]], meaning it is likely just a typo of [[Reaper]]. **Enemies which no longer appear in any capacity but are still ignored include the [[Titus]], [[Conserver]] and [[Hex's Maw]]. ==Update History== *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **'''Mutagenic Blight''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Mutagenic Blight''' can completely negate the stalling effects from towers, such as freeze or [[DJ Booth]] slowdown, if during the debuff it applies [[Nimble]] to the enemy. This will make it walk at its regular [[Nimble]] speed while the debuff effects are still on it. *'''5 March 2025''' - [[v1.56.0]] **Health increased from 4,250 to 10,000. **Speed decreased from Average (3) to Slightly Slow (2). **Defense increased from 30% to 50%. ==Notes== {{PollutedWasteland|[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]]|Wave 16|[[Breaker4]] & Mutagenic Blight|Wave 17|[[Rusher]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
